  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml at the "Hand review round to Claude session (Claude-fixer mode)" step (line 4560 per the consensus finding) — its `if:` condition needs the `env.AUTOFIX_PARTIAL_FINALIZE_REQUESTED != 'true'` guard that every other production step on the Claude-fixer and non-Claude-fixer paths already carries (lines 4603, 4639, 4646, 4652, 4679, 5008, 5664, 5688).
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff does not touch `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` (the PR description confirms it is untouched at 455,461 bytes). `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:run_reviewer_pass` still sets the partial-finalize request whenever `pass_budget_skipped != 0 && pass_hard_failures == 0` (around lines 5178-5180); the two-pass callers exit before the summariser runs (around lines 5246-5249 and 5353-5355) and the single-pass caller does likewise (around lines 5368-5371). The handoff step at line 4560 has no partial-finalize guard, so on a `skipped_budget`-only pass it sources `scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_handoff.sh`, reads `REVIEWER_CONSENSUS_FILE`, sees it is missing, sets `claude_fixer_ledger_state="missing"`, takes the not-clean branch around lines 207-236, and posts a `<!-- ai:claude-fixer-handoff:v1 kind=findings -->` handoff — consuming a `CLAUDE_FIX_HAND_BACK_CAP` slot every time. The partial-finalize continuation / "finish in a later run" steps at lines 6441, 6457, 6490, and 6227 explicitly require `env.CLAUDE_FIXER_MODE != 'true'`, so no rerun path exists for `claude/*` heads. The PR's two new `run_reviewer_pass` tests only check the partial-finalize request file; none drive the workflow step, so the documented behavior is asserted by tests but never reached in a real run. Copilot's review comment at 4159234170 (2026-10-01T18:51:56Z) makes the same observation against the LAST RUN DIFF: "A budget-only partial finalize still reaches this hand-off step… This therefore treats the missing ledger as unclean and posts a Claude hand-off rather than letting the review finish in a later run."
